description: Build and execute command lines from standard input.
Items read from standard input are appended to COMMAND and its initial arguments.

option.name: --arg-file
tip: Read arguments from FILE, not standard input.
When this option is used, stdin remains unchanged when commands are run.

option.name: --delimiter
tip: Items in the input stream are separated by CHARACTER, not by whitespace.
Disables quote and backslash processing and logical EOF processing.

option.name: --eof
tip: Equivalent to -E END if END is specified; otherwise, there is no end-of-file string.
Deprecated; use -E instead, because it is POSIX compliant.

option.name: --exit
tip: Exit if the size (see -s) is exceeded.

option.name: --interactive
tip: Prompt the user about whether to run each command line and read a line from the terminal.
The command line is only run if the response starts with y or Y.

option.name: --max-args
tip: Use at most MAX-ARGS arguments per command line.

option.name: --max-chars
tip: Limit the length of the command line to MAX-CHARS characters, including the command and initial arguments.

option.name: --max-lines
tip: Use at most MAX-LINES non-blank input lines per command line.
Trailing blanks cause an input line to be logically continued on the next input line.
Implies -x.

option.name: --max-procs
tip: Run at most MAX-PROCS processes at a time; the default is 1.
A value of 0 runs as many processes as possible at a time.

option.name: --no-run-if-empty
tip: If the standard input does not contain any non-blanks, do not run the command.
Normally the command is run once even if there is no input.

option.name: --null
tip: Input items are terminated by a null character instead of by whitespace.
Quotes and backslashes are not special, and the end-of-file string is disabled.

option.name: --open-tty
tip: Reopen stdin as /dev/tty in the child process before executing the command.
Useful for running an interactive application.

option.name: --process-slot-var
tip: Set the environment variable VAR to a unique value in each running child process.
Values are reused once child processes exit.

option.name: --replace
tip: Replace occurrences of R in the initial arguments with names read from standard input.
If R is unspecified, assume {}.
-i is deprecated; use -I instead.

option.name: --show-limits
tip: Display the limits on the command-line length imposed by the operating system, the buffer size and the -s option.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Print the command line on the standard error output before executing it.

option.name: -E
tip: Set the logical end-of-file string; if END occurs as a line of input, the rest of the input is ignored.
Ignored if -0 or -d is specified.

option.name: -I
tip: Same as --replace=R.
Unquoted blanks do not terminate input items; the separator is the newline character.
Implies -x and -L 1.

option.name: -l
tip: Similar to -L, but defaults to at most one non-blank input line if MAX-LINES is not specified.
Deprecated; POSIX specifies -L instead.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display this help and exit.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Output version information and exit.
